text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "The target is a dense surrogate auto-increment key (every integer 1–229,205), so any integer column in range like mtgoFoilId (an MTGO foil catalog ID, 57% null) achieves full containment by chance, and semantically a Magic Online foil ID has no relationship to foreign-language card data rows, which link to cards via multiverseid/uuid instead."}
